chain_words.nuance: contaminated by waste or smoke in the environment
made unsafe by a harmful substance getting in
containing chemicals that cause serious harm
able to kill or seriously harm a living thing

explanation: These words all describe something that is not clean, moving from ordinary dirt to a substance that can seriously harm living things.

usage_notes.difference: 'Toxic' describes harmful chemicals in general; 'poisonous' describes something that can make a living thing sick or kill it if it is eaten or touched.
